title: Confidence of Winter's Kiss a #PoetryPort Poem
summary: I have no confidence in the kiss of winter's bliss Hilltops amiss milky blankets never fallen missing soft touches that linger on finger and tongue No slick valleys, sleds up and down Pressure drops in lakes of thought Hiding great winds of doubt from my reality as tears fall to fill the rivers and flow to shores of my soul
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I have
   no confidence
in the kiss
of winter's bliss
Hilltops amiss
milky blankets
   never fallen
missing
soft touches
that linger on finger and
tongue
No slick valleys,
sleds up and
    down
Pressure drops
in lakes of thought
Hiding great winds of doubt
from my reality
as tears fall
    to fill the rivers
and flow to
    shores of
        my soul
